Exact certificates for 321 of the register's 324 counts, n = 105, 130 and 292 not certified; the 273 that do not improve certify a side 1e-20 to 1e-14 above the register's printed one, offered as an independent exact replay of the existing upper bounds with nothing asked to be registered (batch/README.md, results.md); the n = 17 certificate is held and left out here

Two exact checkers in stdlib rational arithmetic, verify_cert.py (separating axes) and verify_cert2.py (vertex containment and edge intersection), accept every certificate (batch/verify_all.sh); reproduce.sh re-solves each input with exactsolve.py and compares the certificate byte for byte

Numerically, not by interval proof: 315 of the 321 are KKT local minima at an 80-digit point, 44 of the 48 improvements among them; n = 177, 211, 230, 261, 263 and 272 are certified bounds only (batch/README.md, s12/search/exact/README.md)
